CREATE TABLE panel_cleaning_schedule (
    id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    sitekey TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES plants(sitekey),
    last_cleaned DATE,
    next_due_date DATE
);

INSERT INTO panel_cleaning_schedule (sitekey, last_cleaned, next_due_date)
SELECT 
    p.sitekey,
    mc_data.last_clean_date::DATE,
    CASE 
        WHEN mc_data.last_clean_date IS NOT NULL AND mc_data.cleaning_cycle_days IS NOT NULL 
        THEN (mc_data.last_clean_date::DATE + (mc_data.cleaning_cycle_days::INTEGER || ' days')::INTERVAL)
        ELSE NULL
    END
FROM plants p
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT 
        mc.mech_health_snapshot->'mount_cleaning'->>'last_clean_date' as last_clean_date,
        mc.mech_health_snapshot->'mount_cleaning'->>'cleaning_cycle_days' as cleaning_cycle_days
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN mechanical_condition mc ON mc.snapmk = pr.snapkey
    WHERE pr.sitetie = p.sitekey
    ORDER BY pr.snapts DESC
    LIMIT 1
) mc_data ON true;
